description: The Tatooine farm boy whose journey links every major setting and drives the Rebel assault.
A skeptical pilot whose connections bridge Luke's group, Leia's rescue, and the final battle.
Rebel leader, prisoner, and strategist whose mission sets the story in motion.
The Imperial enforcer connecting the opening pursuit, Death Star conflict, and trench battle.
Luke's mentor, guiding the group from Tatooine into the Death Star rescue.
The protocol droid whose dialogue and presence connect the heroes' early and middle journeys.
The astromech carrying the Death Star plans and accompanying Luke across the story.
Han's loyal copilot and a constant presence from Mos Eisley through the Rebel victory.
